acceptance_gate.condition: per_candidate_auroc present AND within_question_rank_corr present AND positive_control_valid == true AND flip_count > 0
acceptance_gate.principle: A selection-gap verdict requires the discrimination measure, the within-question decoupling measure, a valid positive control and a fix that actually changed selections -- otherwise it repeats the degenerate-test trap.

field_principles.best_fix_vs_sc_delta_ci: Paired delta + bootstrap CI + McNemar of the BEST fix vs SC -- the gap-closure magnitude + significance.
field_principles.flip_count: Selections changed by the best fix vs SC -- flip_count==0 means a degenerate test (FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISK).
field_principles.inference_substrate: Best-of-N over cached candidates; no LLM generation.
field_principles.oracle_bestofn_accuracy: Upper bound; must exceed SC for the positive control (selectable headroom).
field_principles.per_candidate_auroc: Cross-question discrimination -- confirms the ensemble discriminates (the half that works).
field_principles.positive_control_valid: True iff oracle > SC AND flips > 0 -- without it the null is uninformative (the P0.1 lesson).
field_principles.sc_selection_accuracy: Majority-vote SC baseline accuracy -- the bar.
field_principles.selection_accuracy_per_question_normaliz: FIX A: selection after within-question energy normalization.
field_principles.selection_accuracy_ranking_calibrated: FIX B: selection after a within-question ranking calibration (held-out).
field_principles.selection_gap_closed: BARE bool. True iff at least one fix makes ensemble (or ensemble+self-certainty) selection beat SC with the delta CI excluding 0, positive-control-valid -- the diagnosis verdict. STORE AS BARE true/false.
field_principles.self_certainty_selection_accuracy: FIX C baseline: self-certainty BoN selection (arXiv:2502.18581) -- the stronger free baseline.
field_principles.within_question_rank_corr: Energy-vs-correctness rank correlation WITHIN questions -- the decoupling measure (arXiv:2512.23067).

inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates (principle: best-of-N over cached candidates; no LLM generation).
